resources.string: The buttons next to the folder tabs at the top of the chat list. Hide the ones you don\'t use and the tabs get their room.
Shows while a passcode is set. Without it, XGram locks only with Auto-lock.
Shows while ghost mode is on. Tap it for ghost mode\'s settings.
A bell with a dot for new mentions, replies and reactions, when the navigation doesn\'t have Activity
Chats, people and messages. Ctrl+F on a keyboard searches too.
The ⋮ button stays: while the side menu is hidden, it has the side menu\'s items.
